instructions.purpose: Resolve every requested mod to a stable Modrinth project ID or exact Maven coordinates. Do not guess an ID from a display name.
provider_rules: Use provider=modrinth when a distributable Modrinth mod project exists. Prefer its stable project ID over its slug.
Use provider=maven only for a public standard Maven repository and an artifact that may legally be downloaded and rehosted.
Do not add CurseForge-only projects, direct download URLs, local files, GitHub repositories, credentials, version files, or duplicate mods.
name, description, author, link, and side describe the mod and should be accurate. side must be CLIENT, SERVER, or BOTH.
For Maven, group_id and artifact_id are required; classifier is optional; extension must be jar; modloader may be FORGE, NEOFORGE, FABRIC, QUILT, LITELOADER, VANILLA, or omitted.
Maven minecraft.mode EMBEDDED requires pattern with {minecraft} and {version} exactly once. FIXED requires version. MANUAL leaves every upstream release for an administrator to map later.
Return valid UTF-8 JSON with this exact format and version. solder.py ignores this instructions object and other unknown fields.

metadata_rules.name: Human-readable mod name, up to 255 characters
metadata_rules.description: Short factual description, up to 255 characters
metadata_rules.author: Project owner or accepted team members, up to 255 characters
